feedback.author: mosya415
feedback.body: cc @ch-wan (you wrote most of the DSA backend + arg resolution) and @Fridge003 as an attention/DSA CODEOWNER. Small, self-contained fix: `--dsa-decode-backend flashmla_auto` (and the deprecated `--nsa-decode-backend flashmla_auto`) passes argparse because the decode arg shares the full `DSA_CHOICES` list, but `flashmla_auto` is prefill-only, so the server boots and then hits `assert False, "Unsupported ... flashmla_auto"` at the first decode step. This narrows the decode `choices=` to fail fast at argparse and hardens that `assert` to a `ValueError`. CPU-only unit test included, no model-forward impact. Could someone add the `run-ci` label and take a look? Thanks!

feedback.author: gemini-code-assist[bot]
feedback.body:
## Code Review

This pull request improves the robustness of the XML tool parser by gracefully handling malformed function calls and parameters instead of raising exceptions. Specifically, it replaces `.index()` with `.find()` to avoid raising `ValueError` when the delimiter `>` is missing, returns `None` for unrecoverable malformed headers, skips malformed parameters, and filters out `None` results in `extract_tool_calls`. It also adds corresponding unit tests. The review feedback points out a potential `TypeError` if `tools` is `None` when iterating over it in `_parse_xml_function_call`, suggesting to safely default `tools` to an empty list.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

feedback.author: gemini-code-assist[bot]
feedback.body:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

If `tools` is `None` (which is the default value of `tools` in `extract_tool_calls`), calling `_parse_xml_function_call` will raise a `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable` when it attempts to iterate over `tools` in `get_arguments_config`. We should safely default `tools` to an empty list `tools = tools or []` at the beginning of the method to prevent runtime crashes.

```python
    def _parse_xml_function_call(
        self, function_call_str: str, tools: Optional[list[OpenAIFunctionToolSchema]]
    ) -> Optional[FunctionCall]:
        tools = tools or []
```
